runtime: llama.cpp fork/pinned: card says commit f3f1a8f (CUDA); eval used commit de25343596a2 + native-f32-mmf.patch
method: Independent community reproduction of GSQ+RCO (per-tensor type allocation under exact size budget), 3.5-bit target (3.065 file bpw); not an IST-DASLab release. Embedding shard separate: BF16 or Q4_0 n-gram/Q8_0 token embeddings - the Q4_0/Q8_0 option copies packed tensors from an existing quantized release without requantizing.

methodology.eval_dataset: PPL: unnamed text; MMLU-Pro 2,000 q zero-shot no-reasoning 2,048-token cap; IFEval 16 prompts; GSM8K 8 prompts
methodology.tool: own scripts; 'approx KL' from native uint16 reference cache (formula not given)
